newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet steady, premiums slightly firmer.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet steady, premiums slightly firmer.

text.p: NWE jet fuel oil prices were little changed on Wednesday with softer benchmark IPE gas oil futures countered by slightly firmer barge and cargo premiums after light buying interest emerged on Tuesday, traders said.
Barge premiums were talked around the July IPE +$15 fob ARA with Cargoes differentials talked around July IPE +$17 cif NWE.
Traders said light short-covering interest for barges was supportive against a background of good supplies. They said the contango on benchmark gas oil futures also held premiums up.
Mediterranean markets were supported by short-covering against east-med requirement while traders reported some light buying interest for fob stems. Fob liftings were valued around $173 a tonne.
